name: bulk-select-menu
title: Bulk select menu
description: The header checkbox with a menu for choosing what to select: all, none, unread, starred, with the mixed state and the count in words.
docs: Controlled: derive state (none, some or all) from your own selection and keep the selection in your callbacks. The checkbox runs onSelectAll when nothing is selected and onSelectNone otherwise. Each criterion shows the number it would select and is disabled at 0. After every choice a polite message says what was selected.
